Hi Dylan,

We detected some anomalous API traffic tied to the integration between FinTrack and Redwood between 2026-08-19 02:00-03:15 UTC. Our security/compliance team has asked for your incident response communications and a short timeline of what Redwood would notify customers about in this scenario. Specifically: 1) Do you have a customer-facing notification template we can reuse? 2) Can you provide a sanitized postmortem example and any evidence we can link to in our audit (logs, retention statement)? 3) Are there any SOC 2 control mappings related to notification and log retention you can share?

We're on a tight audit window and would appreciate a response by EOD Aug 21 if possible. If better to discuss, Marcus (copied) can join a quick call.

Thanks,
Priya
Compliance Manager, FinTrack

Subject: RE: Request: incident communication artifacts + IR timeline

Folks,

Quick notes from IR:
- We reviewed the telemetry. The anomalous traffic appears to be credential-stuffing attempts hitting a non-production key tied to FinTrack’s sandbox integration; no downstream data exfiltration indicators observed.
- Timeline draft (UTC):
  * 2026-08-18T01:55: observed unusual auth error rate in proxy metrics
  * 2026-08-18T02:05: automated alert generated and triaged by on-call
  * 2026-08-18T02:20: access token associated with sandbox key rotated and sandbox endpoints rate-limited
  * 2026-08-18T03:05: monitoring returned to baseline
- Evidence we can provide: sanitized log extract (remove all PII/keys), alert traces, and a cleaned postmortem narrative.
- SOC 2 mapping: this maps to CC6 (system operations) and CC7 (change management / incident response notification). I’ll pull the specific control IDs and a short narrative.

Attachments I’ll produce for FinTrack:
- RWD_Sanitized_Postmortem_20260821.pdf (sanitized narrative, root cause, mitigations)
- log_extract_2026-08-20.zip (sanitized logs and alert traces; password-protected)
- RWD_IRP_Summary_2026-08.pdf (public IR plan excerpt tailored for customer sharing)

I recommend we send a single external-facing notification that includes the timeline, impact statement (none to production data), and links to the sanitized artifacts in our secure SharePoint. We should also include an offer for a short 30-min tech briefing.

I’ll have drafts by EOD Aug 20.

— David
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Priya / FinTrack compliance team —

Per our prior notes, please find below Redwood’s customer-facing notification and the sanitized artifacts we've prepared for your audit. If you prefer a different level of detail, let us know and we can redact further.

Summary (short):
- Impact: Non-production sandbox API keys associated with FinTrack experienced credential abuse. No production keys or customer data were accessed. No data exfiltration detected.
- Timeline (UTC, condensed):
  * 2026-08-18T01:55: increased auth failures observed
  * 2026-08-18T02:05 automated alert and triage
  * 2026-08-18T02:20 sandbox key rotated and rate limits applied
  * 2026-08-18T03:05 metrics returned to baseline
- Remediation & follow-up: rotated keys, added anomaly threshold to FinTrack’s sandbox integration view, and scheduled a joint post-incident tech review.

Artifacts (secure links):
- Sanitized postmortem (PDF): RWD_Sanitized_Postmortem_20260821.pdf — narrative, root cause, remedial steps, and lessons learned.
- Log bundle (password-protected ZIP): log_extract_2026-08-20.zip — includes timestamped alerts and metadata (no raw URIs or credential data).
- IR plan excerpt (PDF): RWD_IRP_Summary_2026-08.pdf — customer-facing IR responsibilities and contact matrix.

Access: The files are on Redwood SharePoint (read-only link provided below). The ZIP is password-protected; we’ll provide the password via your security contact or a short call.

SharePoint (read-only): https://redwood-inference.sharepoint.com/sites/compliance/FinTrack-IRP-2026
Contact for technical follow-up: david_kim@redwood.com

If it’s helpful we can 1) schedule a 30-min technical review (David + Marcus + our integration engineer), or 2) provide a short SOC 2 control mapping document (I can attach a one-page mapping to CC6/CC7).

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
